title: Tamago Cucumber Maki
description: Japanese-style sweet-savory egg with cucumber, scallions and sesame.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Whisk eggs with mirin and soy sauce. Cook in thin layers, folding as each layer sets, or form a thick fully cooked omelet.
Cool the omelet and slice into batons; dry cucumber and slice scallions thinly.
Spread rice over nori and add egg strips, cucumber and scallions. Roll securely.
Cut each roll into eight pieces and sprinkle sesame over the cut pieces.
notes: This is a mildly sweet, non-spicy alternative to seafood rolls.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
